summary: Multifragment greedy construction joins cheap edges into paths to build a symmetric TSP tour.
description: Input is a finite symmetric complete distance matrix. Return the vertex order of the final path, with its endpoint connection implicit.

Sort undirected edges and admit one while both endpoints have spare degree and lie in different path components. Union-find detects premature subtours. Sorting the quadratic edge set dominates time. The edge list also uses quadratic space.
